code.label: geography.transportation.hs_code
code.why: Digits-only Schedule B codes of 2, 4, 6 and 10 digits, HS-based like the HTS. Inferred from the values finetype labels this column `unknown`, because a two-digit chapter and a ten-digit commodity share no shape. The label's canonical pattern, `^\d{4}\.?\d{2}(\.?\d{2}){0,2}$`, admits the 6 and 10-digit forms but not the 2-digit chapter or 4-digit heading; describe widens it for them (pattern-fit `widened`), and the contract's length bounds carry the rest.

code_display.label: geography.transportation.hs_code
code_display.why: The code as Census prints it, with dots (0101.21.0000), which the label's canonical pattern admits, as it does the dotted subheading (0101.21). Inferred it is `unknown`, for the same reason as `code`.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The year folder and the file's date, such as 2026/2026-07-27: an identifier for the snapshot. Inferred it is `unknown`; it is not a date, since the year in front is Census's folder.

hts_release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
hts_release.why: USITC's revision name, such as 2026HTSRev22, as on usitc/hts. Inferred, finetype reads it as an ISO week and types the column as a date, which it is not; it is an identifier.

description_short.label: representation.text.plain_text
description_short.why: Census's short description of a commodity ('HORSES, PUREBRED BREEDING, LIVE'). Inferred, finetype labels it an entity name, which it is not; it is prose.

unit_1.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
unit_1.why: Census's unit-of-quantity abbreviations (KG, NO, M2, DOZ, X). Inferred, finetype labels them country codes, which they are not; they are short codes.

unit_2.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
unit_2.why: Census's second unit-of-quantity abbreviations (KG, NO, M2, CTN). Inferred, finetype labels them country codes, which they are not.

sitc.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
sitc.why: SITC Revision 4 codes as Census prints them, five characters, some with X for unspecified digits (792XX). Inferred, finetype labels the column a postal code, which it is not.

end_use.label: representation.identifier.numeric_code
end_use.why: Census's five-digit end-use codes, stored as text. Inferred, finetype labels them integers and the descriptor would type the column as a number, which would drop the leading zeros of codes such as 00300.

hitech.label: representation.identifier.numeric_code
hitech.why: Census's two-digit high-technology codes ('00' to '10'), stored as text. Inferred, finetype labels them integers, which would turn '00' and '01' into 0 and 1.

section.label: representation.text.word
section.why: A Roman numeral naming the schedule section. Inferred it is `unknown`; the value is one short token.
